uncertain.text: i mots. mot ὡς, s. framställer
uncertain.note: The mark over ω looks like a rough breathing, possibly with an acute beside it (ὥς). I kept ὡς because this face's rough breathing often has a tail.

uncertain.text: oss e. sagdt, ὡς ἐν αὐτοῖς
uncertain.note: The mark over ω could be a rough breathing with a grave. I kept ὡς.
The numeral sign after ια is printed as a small apostrophe-like stroke. I kept ʹ (keraia).
